blog: Tirupati is one of the most sacred pilgrimage destinations in India, located in the state of Andhra Pradesh at the foothills of the Eastern Ghats. The city is world-famous for the Sri Venkateswara Temple at Tirumala, which attracts millions of devotees every year and is among the richest and most visited temples in the world. Visitors also explore attractions such as Sri Padmavathi Ammavari Temple, Kapila Theertham, Chandragiri Fort, and Silathoranam. Tirupati is known for its spiritual significance, religious traditions, scenic hills, and vibrant devotional atmosphere. With its deep cultural heritage and strong religious importance, Tirupati remains one of the most revered pilgrimage centers in India.
